narrative: On the tables. The writing-tables open on one small leaf, wiped. Candlelight now. The hand has left four short lines. There is no sum and no name. On the tables. The rest of the leaf is blank. He does not write a house or a figure.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the four lines and did not add a fifth.

entities.name: tables
entities.context: Shown on tables in Wrote that the packet goes and the letter stays
